messages:
emily_cs: Quick pulse on Carina (acct 7832) — noticed a ~3.2x WoW token increase and a 28% QoQ uptick. Need quick triage: is this organic onboarding traffic or a runaway loop? Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/7832 :eyes:

jonah_csm: thanks emily. saw same. onboarding batch started Fri; a webhook retry issue was fixed yesterday but tokens stayed high. Can you paste top endpoints?

emily_cs: top 3 routes: /chat.generate, /chat.streaming, /embeddings.create. Short window sample:
```
2026-03-15 00:00 - 2026-03-21
Total tokens: 4,215,832 (+220% WoW)
Avg p95 latency: 630ms (+110ms WoW)
5xx errors: 0.9% (from 0.2%)
Cost est: $2.7k/wk (up from $900)
```

sasha_support: 5xx spike correlates with `/chat.streaming` retries at 03:12-03:45 UTC. Logs show client reconnect loops. Looks like session resume / retry bug.

mike_dataops: ran a quick cohort: 72% of tokens are from 3 new API keys created last week. Looks like a sandbox importer. Suggest throttling those keys and enable rate limits.

jonah_csm: good catch. @emily_cs can you ask the QAT team if they shipped an import? Also flag renewal risk — if cost keeps rising they'll hit renewal pressure.

emily_cs: pinged customer success PM. Also scheduled an enablement session for next Tue. For now proposing: 1) throttle keys to 10 r/s; 2) enable prefix caching on chat.generate for stable prompts; 3) offer Dedicated trial for predictable costs.

sasha_support: implementing temporary rate limit (10r/s) now. I'll also add a rule to auto-block >500 tokens/s bursts per key for 2 hrs.

deploy-bot: rate-limits-service updated config for customer 7832 by sasha_support (rollout 100%): rule-id rl-7832-temp :thumbsup:

emily_cs: thanks everyone. I'll update the acct health doc and include QoQ/WoW charts. Action items:
- emily_cs: confirm importer source by EOD
- jonah_csm: draft renewal note + cost mitigation proposal by Fri
- mike_dataops: run 24h token attribution report and share
- sasha_support: monitor errors/latency and revert rule when stable

jonah_csm: marked as high attention; renewal risk moved to 'watch' (score 6/10)

emily_cs: closing this thread for now. Will reopen if metrics don't normalize by tomorrow.
